name: Autosize Textarea
description: A textarea that grows and shrinks with its content, capped by a maximum row count.
usage:
<AutosizeTextarea
  label="Bio"
  minRows={2}
  maxRows={6}
  placeholder="Tell us about yourself"
/>

anatomy.description: The visible label associated with the textarea, wired to any description or error text.
The native textarea whose height tracks scrollHeight on every edit, clamped between minRows and maxRows.
Optional description or validation message linked to the field with aria-describedby.

dos: Set minRows so the empty field hints at the expected entry length.
Set maxRows on fields that can grow long, so the form below is not pushed down.
Pair with Field when the entry needs validation messages.
donts: Don't use it when the layout needs a fixed, user-resizable field; use TextArea instead.
Don't leave maxRows unset on comment or log-style inputs with unbounded length.

examples.title: Grow with content
examples.description: The height tracks scrollHeight on every edit, so the field never clips short notes or wastes space on long ones.

examples.title: Capped growth
examples.description: maxRows stops the growth and switches to scrolling, keeping long entries from pushing the form down.

guidance.useWhen: Entries vary widely in length and seeing the whole text matters, such as comments, bios, or feedback boxes.
guidance.avoidWhen: The layout needs a stable, resizable field; use TextArea, which keeps a fixed minimum height and a resize handle.
guidance.behavior: Height follows the content between minRows and maxRows; beyond maxRows the field scrolls instead of growing.
guidance.responsive: The field stretches to fill its container and re-measures on every change, so wrapping text still fits.

notes: The visible label is associated with the textarea; use aria-label when there is no visible label.
Resize is suppressed visually because the field sizes itself; keyboard and screen-reader behavior match a standard textarea.

props.description: Supporting text rendered below the textarea.
props.name: description

props.description: Visible label rendered above the textarea. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used.
props.name: label

props.description: Maximum rows shown before the textarea scrolls instead of growing.
props.name: maxRows

props.description: Rows shown when the content is short.
props.name: minRows
